source_precedence: The attached README defines MVP product behavior.
The user's later direction replaces pokeemerald-expansion with Pokecrossroads Beta 1.4/e05c8286.
The user's later regional rules require qualified identities, battle-region-only minimum tier, one cross-region character/save lineage, and atomic-deny group travel.
implemented_committed: Region-qualified protocol, save progress, identity catalog, map catalog, and regional minimum badge tier
Authentication, exclusive leases, signed revisioned snapshots, resume/fallback, and checkpoint lifecycle
Authenticated server realtime presence with a real two-WebSocket acceptance test
Symmetric two-member groups and atomic-deny region-aware group travel
active_milestone: End-to-end visible presence through ROM, authenticated local control, launcher ticket minting, and supervised realtime lifecycle.
next_ranked_milestones: Player-facing symmetric group invite/accept/decline/leave/reconnect through avatar and pause menu
Authenticated fixed Hoenn trainer reservation, proximity, mutual join confirmation, and deterministic two-ROM battle
Real party selection and battle-region-only downscaling/restoration with expanded trainer teams
Region-qualified progress/reward commit and pre/post-commit crash recovery
Live atomic cross-region movement of both clients and presence repartitioning
not_mvp: PvP, trading, groups above two, voice/free chat, cooperative wild encounters, shared capture, raids, fully shared story, auto-follow, player collision, multiple emulators/builds, offline canonical saves, economy, competitive anticheat
friends, emotes, matchmaking, headless arbiters, spectator mode, visual replay, multi-region server deployment, mobile companion apps
